text:
Afternoon floor staff,
Gate queues came up just now, so just a quick note

Thanks for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady while the pace picks up. Please keep the intake cards tidy and flag any comfort notes as soon as they appear, especially when a pet seems unsettled or the traveler looks unsure. I have already passed along the latest welfare review so the care plan stays matched to each animal's needs, and the cabin team is ready to keep watch once boarding starts.

If anyone sees a crate needing a cleaner setup, a quieter placement, or a small adjustment for species or temperament, please bring it to the desk right away. We do better when we catch the little things early, and that keeps the travelers calmer too. The records are in good shape, so just keep writing clearly and handing off any changes without delay. That helps Aurelia Skyways keep service smooth and the animals comfortable from check-in through arrival.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
